# Mateo (@mateowoetam)

> Developer, privacy advocate, and FOSS enthusiast. Offers privacy/FOSS consulting services (prices in MXN, remote and on-site in Mexico) and publishes digital sovereignty guides in English and Spanish.

This is a static HTML site with no trackers, no cookies, and no third-party requests. Content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. A machine-readable site index is available at [/data/site.json](/data/site.json).

Languages: English (default, `/`) and Spanish (`/es/`). Every page has a language switcher; articles are paired via `hreflang`.

## Pages (English)

- [Home](/): About Mateo and featured Codeberg repositories
- [Services](/services.html): Consulting catalog — PC de-bloat, Linux installs, hardened desktop/mobile OS, identity hardening, home servers, smart homes, local AI compute
- [Writing](/writing.html): Index of privacy and digital-sovereignty guides
- [Contact](/contact.html): Email, GPG fingerprint, social profiles
- [JavaScript license information](/javascript.html): LibreJS web labels for every script served by the site (all CC BY-SA 4.0)

## Páginas (Español)

- [Inicio](/es/index.html): Sobre Mateo y repositorios destacados en Codeberg
- [Servicios](/es/servicios.html): Catálogo de servicios de consultoría
- [Textos](/es/textos.html): Índice de guías de privacidad y soberanía digital
- [Contacto](/es/contacto.html): Correo, huella GPG, redes sociales
- [Información de licencia de JavaScript](/es/javascript.html): Etiquetas LibreJS para cada script del sitio (todos CC BY-SA 4.0)
